recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Resveratrol is a plant stress compound, a stilbene assembled by stilbene synthase from 4-coumaroyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA in grapevine, peanut and Polygonum. Humans have no stilbene synthase and no phenylpropanoid pathway at all, so every molecule in the body arrived from food or a capsule. That means the endogenous axis gives resveratrol no free pass and no handicap: the whole case has to rest on clinical outcomes, and the practical obstacle is that absorbed resveratrol is conjugated almost immediately.

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Astaxanthin is a ketocarotenoid produced by microalgae such as Haematococcus pluvialis and by some bacteria and yeasts, using a beta-carotene ketolase (BKT/CrtW) plus a hydroxylase (CrtZ). Humans synthesise no carotenoids whatsoever and cannot convert beta-carotene into astaxanthin. Salmon and shrimp are pink from the astaxanthin in their food; they do not make it either. Everything in a human body reflects intake, there is no deficiency state to correct, and astaxanthin has no provitamin A activity to fall back on, so the supplement stands or falls on trial results.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 虾青素是一种酮式类胡萝卜素, 由 Haematococcus pluvialis 等微藻以及部分细菌和酵母利用 beta-carotene ketolase (BKT/CrtW) 加羟化酶 (CrtZ) 生成。人体完全不合成任何类胡萝卜素, 也无法把 beta-carotene 转成虾青素。三文鱼和虾之所以呈粉色, 来自其食物中的虾青素, 它们自己也不合成。人体内的全部虾青素都反映摄入量, 没有需要纠正的缺乏状态, 而虾青素也没有维生素 A 原活性可以退守, 因此这种补充剂的成败完全取决于试验结果。

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Curcuminoids are plant polyketides: Curcuma longa builds them from feruloyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA using two type III polyketide synthases, diketide-CoA synthase and curcumin synthase. Humans have no phenylpropanoid pathway and no type III polyketide synthase, so curcumin is a xenobiotic the body can only absorb, conjugate and clear. Endogenous synthesis is irrelevant to the buying decision here, and the operative limit is pharmacokinetic: oral curcumin is glucuronidated and sulfated so fast that free plasma concentrations stay very low.

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: EGCG is a galloylated flavan-3-ol built in the tea plant by the shikimate and phenylpropanoid pathways plus chalcone synthase, with a dedicated epicatechin galloyltransferase adding the gallate group. Humans have none of those enzymes, starting with phenylalanine ammonia-lyase, so intake is the only source and no deficiency exists. On this axis EGCG is optional by definition, which shifts the whole question onto trial benefit and onto safety, where concentrated catechin extracts carry a documented liver injury signal that brewed tea does not.

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: CoQ10 is the clearest redundancy case in the supplement market. Every cell synthesises it de novo through the mevalonate pathway plus PDSS1, PDSS2 and COQ2 to COQ9, there is no DRI, no deficiency syndrome caused by low intake, and dietary intake of a few mg/d is small against endogenous production. Oral doses raise plasma CoQ10 carried in lipoproteins with little evidence of increased mitochondrial content in healthy tissue, so in a healthy adult the supplement duplicates a pathway already running at capacity.

recovered_entries.supplement: Niacin and NAD precursors (nicotinamide, nicotinamide riboside, NMN)
recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Niacin is the quantified partial case: NAD can be built de novo from tryptophan through the kynurenine pathway at roughly 60 mg tryptophan per 1 mg niacin equivalent, which is why the RDA is expressed in niacin equivalents rather than in milligrams of niacin. A protein-adequate diet therefore covers much of the requirement without any preformed niacin. The conversion is not free: it needs riboflavin, vitamin B6 and iron as cofactors, and pellagra appears when niacin and tryptophan are short together, as on maize-based diets or in Hartnup disease.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 烟酸是被量化的部分合成案例：NAD 可由色氨酸经犬尿氨酸通路从头合成，比例约为 60 mg 色氨酸对 1 mg 烟酸当量，这也是 RDA 用烟酸当量而非烟酸毫克数表达的原因。因此蛋白质充足的膳食即使不含现成烟酸，也能覆盖大部分需要量。这一转化并非没有条件：它需要核黄素、维生素B6 和铁作为辅助因子；当烟酸与色氨酸同时不足时会出现佩拉格拉，例如以玉米为主的膳食或 Hartnup 病。

recovered_entries.supplement: Adaptogens, medicinal mushrooms and high-volume polyphenols: Panax ginseng, Eleutherococcus, cordyceps, reishi, chaga, turkey tail, curcumin, resveratrol, quercetin
recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Ginsenosides, eleutherosides, cordycepin, ganoderic acids, fungal beta-glucans, curcuminoids, stilbenes and flavonols are all plant or fungal metabolites with no human pathway, so the axis is silent across the group; adaptogen is a marketing category, not a pharmacological class. Beta-glucans are the partial exception in interest rather than origin, since humans have receptors for them (CLEC7A/dectin-1, CR3) but no synthesis. The three polyphenols share one practical problem: extensive first-pass glucuronidation and sulfation, so plasma aglycone is very low and formulations exist mainly to defeat that metabolism.

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: NAD is not something you can be short of in the way the marketing implies. Humans make niacin from tryptophan at the canonical 60 mg tryptophan to 1 mg niacin equivalent ratio, and far more importantly, the NAMPT salvage pathway recycles nicotinamide released by NAD-consuming enzymes at high flux, which is where most NAD turnover comes from. So the vitamin requirement is real and modest, deficiency is pellagra, and the de novo route from tryptophan plus salvage covers ordinary needs. recovered_entries.endogenous_note: NAD+ is made continuously in every cell, mostly by salvage from nicotinamide, with de novo synthesis from tryptophan and the Preiss-Handler route from nicotinic acid as the other inputs. Nobody on a normal diet lacks NAD+ precursors; the deficiency state is pellagra and it requires a severely restricted diet. NR and NMN do raise blood NAD+ in human trials, so the axis is not a veto, and the open question is whether raised NAD+ changes any clinical outcome, which trials so far have not shown. Oral NMN is also largely dephosphorylated to NR before absorption, so the two products converge.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: NAD+ 在每个细胞内持续合成，主要靠从 nicotinamide 的补救途径，另外还有由色氨酸的从头合成和由 nicotinic acid 的 Preiss-Handler 路线。正常饮食的人不会缺 NAD+ 前体；其缺乏状态是 pellagra，需要极度受限的饮食才会出现。NR 和 NMN 在人体试验中确实提高血中 NAD+，所以这条判据不构成否决，未决的问题是提高 NAD+ 是否改变任何临床结局，目前试验尚未显示。口服 NMN 在吸收前大部分被去磷酸化为 NR，因此两种产品实际趋同。

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Four labels are used, and adequate quantity is judged against basal physiological function at the tissue's normal set point, not against a storage ceiling and not against the dose a trial happened to use. FULL: the human pathway is complete and output covers basal need in health. PARTIAL: the pathway exists but output is structurally capped below what the relevant pool or function needs, so dietary supply routinely contributes. recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 全表用四个标签, 判断供应是否充足的基准是健康状态下组织在正常设定点的基础生理功能, 不按储存池上限, 也不按某项试验所用剂量。FULL: 人体通路完整, 健康时自身产量覆盖基础需要。PARTIAL: 通路存在, 但产量在结构上被限制在相关池或功能所需之下, 饮食供应经常性参与。CONDITIONAL: 健康时够用, 在明确点名的状态下不够用。NONE: 人体完全没有该生物合成通路, 所有化学元素都归此类, 因为没有生物能合成元素。标签是描述性的: NONE 不含需求含义 (caffeine 和 quercetin 是 NONE 且无需求, vitamin C 和 zinc 是 NONE 但有需求也有缺乏症), FULL 也不能判定药理剂量是否有效 (melatonin 即是)。

recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Use the axis to decide whether a product has a target, then use pharmacology and trial evidence to decide whether it works. The axis can kill a premise (glucosamine, collagen as a molecule, test boosters) and it can support one (creatine, beta-alanine, vitamin C at low intake, B12 in a vegan). It never settles efficacy on its own.
recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 先用这条轴判断产品有没有可作用的目标, 再用药理学和试验证据判断它是否有效。这条轴能否掉某些前提 (glucosamine, 作为分子的 collagen, 睾酮增强类产品), 也能支持某些前提 (creatine, beta-alanine, 摄入不足时的 vitamin C, 纯素者的 B12), 但它本身从不判定疗效。
